description: A New Thorn Mercury 40 with Rohloff in stunning Orange - 58L - Straight Bar bike. This bike would be ideal for light to medium touring on sealed or broken roads . This bike would suit a rider of 5ft 10 (1780 mm )- 6ft 2 ( 1880mm) approx. If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk.
